name: バカリズムのちょっとバカりハカってみた
original_name: バカリズムのちょっとバカりハカってみた
overview: Centred on the theme of ‘measuring, gauging, quantifying, charting, plotting and consulting’—all encompassed by the Japanese word ‘hakaru’—this variety show sees the production team earnestly and single-mindedly ‘measuring’ every conceivable phenomenon in the world. From the simple, everyday questions that suddenly pop into your head—the kind that make you think, ‘Now that you mention it, that really is a bit of a mystery’—to things that make you chuckle, and even grand themes that pique your intellectual curiosity, the team tackles it all with sweat and passion!
